stupid app keeps glitching
worst app tbh it freezes every single time whenever I open it and even after reinstalling

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that the app crashes, freezes, and glitches, making it unusable for trading tasks such as placing stop‑loss orders and accessing features.
themes.business_impact: High probability of user churn, loss of daily trading volume, reputational damage in the brokerage market, and potential financial losses for users due to missed trades.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: Inadequate error handling, memory leaks, and unstable third‑party library integrations lead to frequent crashes and freezes during launch and operation.
themes.action_plan:
• Conduct crash analytics review and identify top crash logs
• Rebuild critical modules with robust exception handling and memory optimization
• Implement automated testing for crash scenarios
• Roll out incremental OTA updates; monitor crash rates
• Communicate transparently with users, offering temporary workarounds

themes.description: Users consistently report that the brokerage fees are excessively high compared to competitors, leading to dissatisfaction and loss of trust.
themes.business_impact: Customers are switching to cheaper brokers (e.g., Zerodha), resulting in reduced trading volume, lower transaction revenue, and increased churn for high‑frequency traders.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The current fee structure is not aligned with market rates and may include hidden or excessive per‑transaction charges, leading to a perception of unfairness and lack of transparency.
themes.action_plan:
• Benchmark current fees against top competitors
• Redesign fee schedule to offer tiered or volume‑based discounts
• Remove or reduce hidden fees (e.g., external charges)
• Communicate fee changes clearly through in‑app messaging and support docs
• Pilot new pricing with a subset of users and measure impact on trade activity and churn
• Roll out across all users and monitor key metrics

themes.name: [Negative] Chart Performance & Load Time Issues

quotes.text: chart is not working smoothly
chart delay
serious lagging issues nowadays...chart not refreshing 😕
charts are not opening properly

themes.description: Users repeatedly report that charts fail to load, become laggy, or do not refresh, especially on mobile devices during live market hours.
themes.business_impact: Critical trading users experience delayed price information, which can lead to missed opportunities, reduced trade volume, and higher churn among professional traders who rely on real-time data.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The charting stack is overfetching complete datasets and rendering them with a non-virtualized JavaScript chart library, causing high memory usage and slow DOM updates; backend APIs may lack pagination or compression, and network latency is not mitigated by CDN caching.
themes.action_plan:
• Profile client-side rendering to identify heavy components
• Optimize data fetching by paginating or incremental updates
• Implement WebSocket or SSE for live updates
• Reduce payload size through compression and field pruning
• Enable aggressive caching with proper cache headers
• Refactor chart rendering to use a GPU-accelerated native or canvas library
• Add performance thresholds and alerting
• Perform A/B testing before full rollout
